_comment_typescript: typescript stays on ^6 for now — TS 7 (native Go compiler) ships no classic JS compiler API, which vue-tsc/@volar (nuxt typecheck) needs, and @typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0; revisit when vue-tsc supports TS 7.1 and typescript-eslint widens its peer range (see .sb-context/dependency-notes.json)
_comment_overrides: esbuild pinned to ^0.28.0 for dedup only — GHSA-67mh is fixed upstream by all consumers now (@nuxt/fonts ^0.27.0, @nuxtjs/i18n's @intlify/bundle-utils ^0.25.4, nuxt's nitropack ^0.28.0); without this override npm would install two esbuild copies since the ^0.25.4 range doesn't overlap ^0.28.0
